```{julia}
using CairoMakie
using LinearAlgebra

using MMJMesh.Plots
using MMJMesh.Mathematics
```

## Bohrpfahl

### Ausgangspunkt

Problemparameter

```{julia}
# Basiswerte
E = 35e9
d = 0.8
l = 20
F = 2e6
ρ = 2500
g = 9.81
S = 120e6
c = 1.75e7

# Abgeleitete Werte
C = c * π * d
A = π * d^2 / 4
EA = E * A
n = ρ * g * A;
```

Exakte Lösung

```{julia}
x = parameter(0 .. l)
λ = sqrt(C / EA)
D = EA * λ * sinh(λ * l) + S * cosh(λ * l)
u = n/C*(1 - S*cosh(λ*x)/D) + F/(EA*λ*D)*(EA*λ*cosh(λ*(l - x)) + S*sinh(λ*(l - x)))
N = EA * u'

fig = Figure()
fplot!(Axis(fig[1, 1], title="Verschiebung u"), u, zero(x))
fplot!(Axis(fig[2, 1], title="Normalkraft N"), N, zero(x))
fig
```

Schwache Form

```{julia}
a(u, δu) = integrate(EA * u' * δu' + C * u * δu, 0 .. l) + S * u(l) * δu(l)
b(δu) = integrate(n * δu, 0 .. l) + F * δu(0)
```

### Näherungslösung

Berechnen

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
Ne = 4
phis = hatfunctions(range(0 .. l, Ne + 1))
K = [a(phi_j, phi_i) for phi_i = phis, phi_j = phis]
r = [b(phi_i) for phi_i = phis]
uHat = K \ r
uh = uHat ⋅ phis
fplot(uh, u)
```
:::
::: {.tinh-scaffold}
```{julia}
# Ne = 4
# phis = ...
# K = ...
# r = ...
# uHat = ...
# uh = ...
# fplot(...)
```
:::

Normalkraft

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
Nh = EA * uh'
fplot(Nh, N)
```
:::

Fehler

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
fplot(0 * x, u - uh)
```
:::

```{julia}
fplot(phis...)
```

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}

```
:::

### Galerkin-Orthogonalität

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
[a(u - uh, phi_i) for phi_i = phis]
```
:::

Testfunktion, die keine Linearkombination der Basisfunktionen ist

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
δu = sin(x)
a(u - uh, δu)
```
:::

### Funktion

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
function pile_fem(Ne)
    phis = hatfunctions(range(0 .. l, Ne + 1))
    K = [a(phi_j, phi_i) for phi_i = phis, phi_j = phis]
    r = [b(phi_i) for phi_i = phis]
    uHat = K \ r
    uh = uHat ⋅ phis
    return uh
end

uh = pile_fem(4)
fplot(uh, u)
```
:::

### Fehler und Normalkraft

Näherungslösungen einmal berechnen

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
Nes = 2 .^ (1:6)
uhs = pile_fem.(Nes);
```
:::

Fehlerfunktion

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
fig = Figure()
Axis(fig[1, 1])
for uh = uhs
    fplot!(u - uh)
end
fig
```
:::

Normalkraft

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
fig = Figure()
Axis(fig[1, 1])
fplot!(N)
for uh = uhs
    Nh = EA * uh'
    fplot!(Nh, connect_jumps=true)
end
fig
```
:::

### Konvergenz

Fehler in der Energienorm berechnen

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
energynorm(v) = sqrt(a(v, v))

hs = l ./ Nes
es = [100 * energynorm(u - uh) / energynorm(u) for uh = uhs]
```
:::

Fehler plotten

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
scatterlines(hs, es)
```
:::

Fehler in loglog-Skala plotten

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
fig = Figure()
Axis(fig[1, 1], xscale=log2, yscale=log10, title="Fehler in Prozent")
scatterlines!(hs, es)
fig
```
:::

Steigung im loglog-Plot

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
log2.(es[1:(end-1)] ./ es[2:end])
```
:::

## Balken auf zwei Federn

### Näherungslösung

Schwache Form

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
# Systemparameter in N und m
EI = 2.1e11 * 8.356e-5
l = 8
q = 50e3
k = 1e7

a(w, δw) = EI * integrate(w'' * δw'', 0 .. l) + k * (w(0) * δw(0) + w(l) * δw(l))
b(δw) = q * integrate(δw, 0 .. l)
```
:::

Berechnen

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
Ne = 8
phis = hermitefunctions(range(0 .. l, Ne + 1))
K = [a(phi_j, phi_i) for phi_i = phis, phi_j = phis]
r = [b(phi_i) for phi_i = phis]
wHat = K \ r
wh = wHat ⋅ phis
Mh = -EI * wh''
Vh = Mh'
```
:::

Lösung plotten

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
fig = Figure()
fplot!(Axis(fig[1, 1], title="Durchbiegung"), wh, zero(wh))
fplot!(Axis(fig[2, 1], title="Biegemoment und Querkraft"), Mh, Vh, zero(wh))
fig
```
:::

### Differentialgleichung

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
fplot(EI * wh'''' - q)
```
:::

### Randbedingungen

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
println("Vh(0) = ", Vh(0), ", soll ", q * l / 2)
println("Vh(l) = ", Vh(l), ", soll ", -q * l / 2)
println("Mh(0) = ", Mh(0), ", soll 0")
println("Mh(l) = ", Mh(l), ", soll 0")
println("Mh(l/2) = ", Mh(l / 2), ", Einfeldträger ", q * l^2 / 8)
```
:::

### Zusätzlicher Knoten

Basisfunktionen

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
Ne = 2
phis = hermitefunctions(range(0 .. l, Ne + 1), midnode=true)
fplot(phis...)
```
:::

Näherungslösung und Prüfung

::: {.tinh-solution}
```{julia}
K = [a(phi_j, phi_i) for phi_i = phis, phi_j = phis]
r = [b(phi_i) for phi_i = phis]
wHat = K \ r
wh = wHat ⋅ phis
Mh = -EI * wh''
Vh = Mh'

println("Vh(0) = ", Vh(0), ", soll ", q * l / 2)
println("Vh(l) = ", Vh(l), ", soll ", -q * l / 2)
println("Mh(0) = ", Mh(0), ", soll 0")
println("Mh(l) = ", Mh(l), ", soll 0")
println("Mh(l/2) = ", Mh(l / 2), ", Einfeldträger ", q * l^2 / 8)

fplot(EI * wh'''' - q)
ylims!(-1e-5, 1e-5)
current_figure()
```
:::
